2610.12086.title: EvoAlloc: A Self-Evolving Resource Allocation Agent for Efficient Program Evolution
2610.12086.paper_summary: LLM-based program evolution relies on evaluation feedback to guide the iterative search for high-performing programs. However, evaluation is often computationally expensive, making it essential to allocate limited resources to candidates that can most effectively advance the search. Existing LLM-based methods typically rely on fixed allocation strategies throughout the search, potentially wasting resources on low-value candidates while overlooking promising ones. We propose EvoAlloc, a self-evolving resource-allocation agent that learns from search experience to revise its strategy for allocating computational resources across candidates. EvoAlloc periodically consolidates prior search and allocation outcomes into reusable experience, which informs subsequent strategy revisions. It further uses a counterfactual exploration mechanism to occasionally evaluate candidates denied resources by the allocator, revealing their outcomes to enrich its experience for future strategy updates. Across coding and agent-harness optimization benchmarks, EvoAlloc requires 59-82% fewer full evaluations and 61-89% fewer total LLM tokens to reach baseline-level performance. Moreover, under the same full-evaluation budget, EvoAlloc achieves 8.7-12.0% higher final performance.
2610.12086.paper_summary_zh: LLM 基於的程式演化依賴評估反饋來引導對高效能程式的迭代搜尋。<lb/>然而，評估通常計算成本高昂，因此必須將有限的資源分配給能最有效推進搜尋的候選者。<lb/>現有的 LLM 基於方法通常在搜尋過程中依賴固定的資源分配策略，這可能會浪費資源在低價值的候選者上，同時忽略有潛力的候選者。<lb/>我們提出了 EvoAlloc，一個自我演化的資源分配代理，能從搜尋經驗中學習，以修訂其在候選者之間分配計算資源的策略。<lb/>EvoAlloc 定期將先前的搜尋和分配結果整合成可重用的經驗，這些經驗為後續的策略修訂提供參考。<lb/>它進一步使用反事實探索機制，偶爾評估被分配器拒絕資源的候選者，揭示其結果以豐富其未來策略更新的經驗。<lb/>在編碼和代理優化基準測試中，EvoAlloc 需要 59-82% 更少的完整評估和 61-89% 更少的總 LLM 代幣才能達到基準性能。<lb/>此外，在相同的完整評估預算下，EvoAlloc 實現了 8.7-12.0% 更高的最終性能。
